sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for sharing your data regarding the volume increase and our delivery performance, which we have reviewed. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to accept the 24-month contract and 14-day payment terms from your third package. In response to your verified data, we can reduce our price to €5.50 per unit for this package.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, we can offer a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €5.50 per unit.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that volume change data into account, and thank you for your commitment to 30,000 pieces per year over 24 months. Please note that the forecast increase you mentioned was already factored into our previous calculation.

Our offer is a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. In recognition of your volume commitment, we can reduce our price to €5.40 per unit for the 14-day payment term, offering an alternative of a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for the updated packages and your continued commitment to 30,000 pieces per year. We have already taken that volume change data into account, and please note that the additional forecast increase you mentioned has already been factored into our calculations.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is a price of €5.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

In response to your movement, we can offer a further reduced price of €5.36 per unit for the 14-day payment term, alongside a price of €5.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please be aware that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
